examples.src: **It is a binding process, but not enforceable unless there is an agreement between the parties. Unlike judicial adjudication, arbitration is not a judicial process, and the courts will only enforce the agreement if one of the parties invokes its jurisdiction. Negotiation does not require a third party or neutral person, and the process is informal with no laid-down rules or regulations. Mediation, on the other hand, involves a third party who facilitates the process but has no power to impose a resolution. Both negotiation and mediation are voluntary and private processes, unlike arbitration which can be binding. The TKI is an instrument designed by Ralph Kilmann and Kenneth Thomas in the early 1970s to assess an individual's behavior in conflict situations. It evaluates five conflict management styles: competing, collaborating, compromising, avoiding, and accommodating. The instrument was initially skewed towards collaboration as the most efficient way, but the authors later developed a thirty-test-based question pairs to test the behavior of an individual more accurately. Yes, the TKI can help individuals identify their dominant mode and hierarchy of responses. By understanding the options available, individuals can make conscious decisions to change their style and develop new skills. The instrument emphasizes that individuals are capable of changing their main mode and hierarchy of responses, and with a conscious effort, they can adopt a more constructive approach to managing conflicts.**
examples.ref: **Ɛyɛ adeyɛ a ɛkyekyere nnipa, nanso sɛ apam biara nni afã horow no ntam a, wontumi mfa nni dwuma. Nea ɛnte sɛ ntamgyinafo no, ntamgyinafo nyɛ atemmu nhyehyɛe, na sɛ afã horow no mu biako de tumidi di dwuma nkutoo a, asennibea ahorow bɛhyɛ apam no mu den. Nkitahodi nhwehwɛ sɛ obi a ɔto so abiɛsa anaa obi a onni afã biara na ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no nyɛ nea wɔahyɛ da ayɛ a mmara ne nhyehyɛe biara nni hɔ. Ɔkwan foforo so no, ntamgyinafo fa obi a ɔto so abiɛsa a ɔma adeyɛ no yɛ mmerɛw nanso onni tumi sɛ obesi gyinae ho. Nkitahodi ne ntamgyinafo nyinaa yɛ nea wofi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ ne kokoam nhyehyɛe, ɛnte sɛ ntamgyinafo a ebetumi ayɛ nea ɛkyekyere. TKI yɛ adwinnadeɛ a Ralph Kilman ne Kenneth Thomas yɛeɛ wɔ 1970 mfeɛ no mfitiaseɛ mu de hwɛɛ ankorankoro nneyɛeɛ wɔ ntawntawdie tebea mu. Ɛhwehwɛ akwan anum a wɔfa so di ntawntawdi ho dwuma: Akansi, Bom, Mpata, Kwati, ne Agyede. Mfiase no na adwinnade no twee adwene sii adwumayɛkuw so sɛ ɔkwan a etu mpɔn sen biara, nanso akyiri yi akyerɛwfo no yɛɛ nsɛmmisa abien a egyina sɔhwɛ ahorow aduasa so de sɔɔ onipa no nneyɛe hwɛe pɛpɛɛpɛ. Yiw, TKI betumi aboa ankorankoro ma wɔahu wɔn tumidi ne mmuae nhyehyɛe. According to research, construction projects are vulnerable to various risks, including technical, socio-political, and business risks. These risks can be hindering to the development of the construction sector. Additionally, the complexity and changing circumstances of construction projects create an atmosphere of high risk and uncertainty.

Risk management is essential in construction projects because it helps identify potential risks and react to them. It's widely considered that there is a choice in discovering risk in a specific domain, and it can't be reduced to mere destiny. The satisfaction of project and stakeholder business objectives can be influenced by the inherent vulnerabilities in the system. Effective risk management can help construction projects achieve their objectives, including quality, environmental sustainability, time, cost, and health.

Sɛnea nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ no, adansi adwuma yɛ mmerɛw sɛ asiane ahorow a mfiridwuma, asetra ne amammuisɛm ne aguadi mu asiane ahorow ka ho. Saa asiane ahorow yi betumi ayɛ akwanside ama adansi adwuma no nkɔso. Nea ɛka ho no, adansi adwuma a ɛyɛ den na ɛyɛ nnam no de asiane kɛse ne adwenem naayɛ ba.

Asiane ho dwumadie ho hia wɔ adansiɛ adwuma mu ɛfiri sɛ ɛboa ma wɔhunu asiane a ɛbɛtumi aba na wɔadi ho dwuma. Wosusuw kɛse sɛ paw bi wɔ hɔ a wobetumi apaw sɛ wobehu asiane wɔ ɔfã pɔtee bi mu na wontumi ntew so mma nkrabea nkutoo. Dwumadie ne wɔn a wɔdi dwuma no adwumayɛ botaeɛ akomatɔyam no bɛtumi anya nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ mmerɛwyɛ a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛeɛ no mu a ɛwɔ hɔ awosuo mu. Asiane ho dwumadie a ɛtu mpɔn bɛtumi aboa adansiɛ adwuma ama wɔadu wɔn botaeɛ ho, a nea ɛka ho ne papayɛ, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa, berɛ, ɛka ne akwahosan.
examples.dict:
Sɛnea nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ no, adansi dwumadi yɛ mmerɛw wɔ asiane ahorow mu, a mfiridwuma, asetra mu amammuisɛm ne adwuma mu asiane ka ho. Saa asiane yi betumi asiw adansi dwumadibea no nkɔsoɔ kwan. examples.src: It is a plan in place to show what the nation needs and to do the work well. As the report indicates, the other projects should have also been going on quickly, but it seems the progress is like small drops of water. **In this nation, things like this often happen.** Sometimes there is no budget, or sometimes all the things there don't go as they wanted. Only the Koforidua project is apparent as something finished and given to the people. The discourse they had, it was in it that he spoke about the things that are there, but the issue is that the work they will do, it must move forward. Keke Palmer's matter is also like that. Hollywood is a place that many people want to go, but she herself is saying she can leave because she has no joy anymore. This means that if a job has no benefit, anyone can lose their mind. He said, President Akufo-Addo will not stand aside to let soldiers and guards who involve themselves in people's problems on the road, if the day arrives that everyone will account for it. This matter filled the road program greatly. And all these politicians say they want the nation's well-being, but what is going on shows that things are not smooth. The music program that used to be a place of joy, today it has become politics and joy that has no understanding. The President who Mr. Nketia spoke about, it is one we must watch well. If the nation's guards continue to do things that are not what they should do, it will destroy the nation's name. *So, this matter is one that must show us that we have understanding in what is going on in our nation.* From the year 2000 until today, our music program is changing as it goes. However, history shows that, if there is no president who will protect his soldiers, then it means their work has a path they must follow. Mr. Asiedu Nketia continued to say that, if the nation will be beautiful, everyone must do their work well, and it is not politics alone that is there. Our politics work is also needed well, but music and things that concern culture are also things we must keep. This understanding is what will show us the path in the days that are coming.

examples.src: The study found that employees' perception of organizational support is vital for determining their attitudes to work. The study identified several problems, including lack of supervisor support, lack of justice and fair treatment, inadequate organizational rewards, unfavorable working conditions, unstructured succession plan, and poor superior-subordinate relationship. These problems highlighted the need for organizational support to manage employees' behavior and attitude to work. The general objective of the study was to examine the effect of organizational support on employees' attitude to work. The specific objectives included identifying the various forms of organizational support existing in the University, finding out whether organizational support yields positive employees' attitude to work, and recommending appropriate organizational support measures for adoption by the University. **The study aimed to provide insight into how organizational support should be developed and implemented for adoption.** The study's findings are significant because they highlight the importance of adopting organizational support for developing positive attitudes among employees. The results can serve as an important document for the management of the University of Education, Winneba-Kumasi Campus to evaluate the extent to which organizational support can be adopted as a practice and policy for influencing staff commitment and attitude to work. *The study's findings can also be replicated in other institutions in Ghana.*

## According to the research, there are indeed influences on the choice of procurement method.

- These influences come from suppliers, management, and political leaders.
- For instance, management may ask for procurement to be divided into items, which can be caused by external factors.
- Additionally, politicians and suppliers can also exert influence on the procurement process, sometimes leading to conflicts with the provisions of the law.
- Actually, the research suggests that poor records management is not a major problem in this context.
- While there are some issues with filing systems due to cost constraints, the procurement process is generally well-documented.
- However, there are instances where documents are difficult to locate, which can cause delays in the procurement process.
- Economic and market conditions do have an impact on the procurement process.
- Changes in market prices, for example, can affect the procurement plan.

On the fifteenth of July in the year twenty twenty-two, Challenging Heights, a local Ghanaian anti-slavery organization, rescued eleven children from forced labour on Lake Volta. The children, nine males and two females, were between the ages of eight and sixteen and had been working as child fishermen for several years without attending school. They were also subjected to various forms of abuse.

According to Challenging Heights, sixty percent of all children on Lake Volta are child labourers. This is based on a comprehensive report titled 'Hidden in Plain Sight: A report on child labor in the fishing industry of Ghana'. The organization is committed to fighting against child labour exploitations, especially in the fishing industry in Ghana.

In Ghana, some common methods used for early detection of breast cancer include Mammography, Clinical breast examination, and Breast Self-examination. However, Mammography is very expensive and not feasible for most developing countries like Ghana, so Breast Self-examination is often recommended as a cheap and non-invasive alternative.

Breast Self-examination is a simple and inexpensive method that can be effective in detecting breast cancer, especially in developing countries where access to mammography is limited. However, it's essential to practice it the right way to achieve good results. Most breast cancers present with a painless lump, and women who are breast-aware through education and regular screening practices are more likely to report to health facilities early, resulting in better management.

Nhwehwɛmu no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛma wɔanya nsusuwii mu nnyinaso a wɔde bedi nsɛmmisa a ɛfa nufu mu kokoram ho ne nhwehwɛmu a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ mmabun nufu mu kokoram ho ho dwuma.
examples.dict:

Nanso, ɛwom sɛ nnuufoɔ mu kokoram abu so wɔ aman apon mu de, nanso aman te sɛ Ghana wɔ owuo dodow a ɛkɔ soro.

Forest habitat loss and fragmentation in Central Poland has been a significant issue over the last one hundred years. Research has shown that the landscape has undergone substantial changes, leading to the loss of biodiversity and ecosystem degradation. However, initiatives like REDD+ and sustainable agroforestry practices are being explored to mitigate and adapt to climate change.

The study on soil organic carbon pools after agricultural abandonment found that the dynamics of soil carbon are influenced by factors such as land use change, soil type, and climate. The research suggested that the abandonment of agricultural land can lead to an increase in soil organic carbon, which has implications for carbon sequestration and climate change mitigation.

examples.src: The large crowd gathered there stood to watch him. *When he reached a point where he was singing, KiDi stopped his song in the middle.* That was where he performed an act that showed respect and a mindset that shows he cares about our culture. It was a time he was speaking about a Highlife legend who is in his life who has gone ahead of him. He stood there, his voice became heavy, and he explained how that elder's influence is on his singing. The New York people who were there became silent. **It is not that they knew all the songs, but they felt that it was someone who shows respect who was speaking.** KiDi let the people realize that if you will be a winner in any world, you must think about what they did first to do the work. He said, "Highlife is our culture, and I too stand on history and I am doing my thing." It was wonderful joy on that summer stage. The people started to move, and they understood what KiDi was saying. It is a time that shows Ghana music has come onto great activities, and people who lead like KiDi, they know that respect is what we must hold onto. He continued his singing, and the evening ended in a way that is joyful. It is a matter that shows Ghana music is going forward, but we hold onto our history.
examples.ref: Nnipa dɔm no pii a wɔahyia wɔ hɔ no gyina bɛhwɛɛ no. *Eduu baabi a na ɔretoo dwom no, KiDi gyaee ne dwom no kwan so.* Ɛhɔ na ɔdii dwuma a ɛkyerɛɛ nidi ne adwene a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔdwen yɛn amammerɛ ho. Ná ɛyɛ bere a ɔreka Highlife legend bi a ɔwɔ ne nkwa mu a ɔkɔɔ n’anim no ho asɛm. Ɔgyinaa hɔ, ne nne yɛɛ no duru, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ mu sɛnea saa ɔpanyin no nsunsuansoɔ da ne dwomtoɔ so. New York nnipa a wɔwɔ hɔ no bɛyɛɛ komm. **Ɛnyɛ sɛ na wɔnim nnwom no nyinaa, nanso na wɔte nka sɛ obi a ɔda nidi adi na ɔreka.** KiDi maa nnipa no hui sɛ, sɛ wobɛyɛ nkonimdifoɔ wɔ wiase biara, ɛsɛ sɛ wususuw nea wɔdi kan yɛɛ adwuma no ho. Ɔkae sɛ, "Highlife ne yɛn amammerɛ, na me nso megyina abakɔsɛm so na mereyɛ me deɛ. " Ɛyɛɛ anigyeɛ nwanwa wɔ saa summer stage no so. Nnipa no bɛhyɛɛ aseɛ reretwi, na wɔte nea KiDi reka no ase. Ɛyɛ bere a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Ghana music no aba dwumadie akɛseɛ so, na nnipa a wɔdi anim te sɛ KiDi no, wɔnim sɛ nidi ne nea ɛsɛ sɛ yɛkura mu. Ɔtoaa ne dwomtoɔ no so, na anwummerɛ no baa awiei wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ anigyeɛ so. Ɛyɛ asɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Ghana dwom kɔ anim, nanso yɛnkura yɛn abakɔsɛm mu.

## THE EXPERIMENT INVOLVED HEATING FORTY-ONE EMPTY CRUCIBLES IN A MUFFLE FURNACE AT 600ºC, THEN COOLING AND WEIGHING THEM TO THE NEAREST POINT ONE MILLIGRAMS.

1. A two grams sample of air-dried B. aethiopum was then placed in the crucibles to determine the weight of the crucibles and the specimen.
2. The heating process was used to determine the moisture content (MC) of the B. aethiopum sample.
3. The crucibles and their contents were placed in a drying oven at one hundred and three ± 2ºC, cooled in a desiccator, and weighed until the weights were constant.

examples.src: This method seems to be effective, as the percentage germination and vigor of the farmer-saved seeds collected from the various ecological zones were high, ranging from sixty-eight point six nine to ninety-eight percent. Yes, the study did find evidence of seed-borne pathogens. None of the seed samples were free from seed-borne pathogens and saprophytic fungi, with forty-five inchesfected with eight fungi, comprising five pathogenic and three saprophytic fungi. *However, it's worth noting that the disease symptoms of these fungi were not observed on the field when infected seeds were sown, suggesting that good agricultural practices can prevent disease development.* Yes, the study found significant differences in the vegetative and reproductive growth of the tomato seeds among the various ecological zones. **The samples from the Forest zone, for example, flowered the earliest, but also recorded the lowest number of fruits per plant and least yield of ten point three t/ha.** In contrast, the samples from the Sudan savanna zone had the highest weight of marketable fruits per plant and fruit yield per hectare. Yes, the study found a positive relationship between percentage seed vigor and fruit yield. The samples that recorded the highest percentage germination of ninety-eight percent and ninety-five point eight also gave the highest fruit yields of fifteen point six and nineteen point five t/ha. This suggests that seed vigor is an important factor in determining fruit yield.

examples.src: The research instruments were developed and pretested before they were administered. The questionnaire was divided into six parts, and two separate interview guides were designed for separate interviews with the Management and the selected employees of the Commission. The questionnaires were administered by the Registrars of the selected offices, who were properly oriented by the researcher. The data was quantitatively and qualitatively analyzed. *Quantitative data analysis was done using Microsoft Word two thousand and seven and statistical techniques such as descriptive statistics, regression, and correlation tests were conducted.* Multiple regression analysis was conducted to examine the relationship between service quality and customer satisfaction. The results were presented using tables, graphs, and charts to facilitate easy understanding of the analysis and findings. **Additionally, frequency distribution and percentages were used to analyze the profile of the respondents and to determine the proportion of respondents choosing various responses.** The qualitative analysis was done by writing down the themes based on the research objectives and research questions, and the issues discussed accordingly. This involved identifying patterns and themes in the data and presenting them in a way that facilitated easy understanding of the findings.

Sɛnea nhwehwɛmu no kyerɛ no, nsɛnnennen akɛse no mu biako ne ‘abusuabɔ’ a wɔde bedi dwuma, a ɛma wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ adwuma no binom nya mfaso a ɛnteɛ sen afoforo. Adwumakuw no nam aguade ho dawurubɔ ahorow a wɔbɔ wɔ atesɛm nkrataa mu ne wɔn adwumakuw no wɛbsaet so so bɔ adwuma a ɛda hɔ ho dawuru.

examples.src: On a joyful Sunday morning, Trump wrote on Truth Social that he is appointing Tammy Bruce, a "Great Patriot" and television personality, as the United States deputy ambassador to the United Nations. This issue shook many people's minds. In politics, they say Tammy Bruce is someone who is dedicated to her nation, and her presence in international circles will give the United States a new path to state their position. However, while we wait for these changes, there are issues we must approach. At the Ghana Revenue Authority (GRA) office, it’s not just politics they are talking about, but changes in the journey and operation. They said that, in the past, when they wanted to measure the oil in a large tanker, they used a "dipstick" to indicate it. That means the official in charge would climb the ladder on the tanker and go up, and drop the dipstick to the bottom. That means there is great danger. If an accident happens, the official will fall, and his life is at risk. GRA’s guidelines and training show that this outdated method has passed. If they want to preserve people's lives, they must use the new things that are currently available. If they continue with technology, it will make the work faster, and risk will also decrease. This is an issue that affects us all. It's not just what concerns politics, but it concerns the way we do things on our journey. If we continue to hold onto old habits, we will lose travelers on the journey. Past things must be left behind so we can use new things that will make our workplaces safe. The selection of Tammy Bruce is a start for taking a new path. Just as GRA changes the way they measure oil, so too must politics change.
examples.ref: Wɔ kwasida anɔpa bi a ɛyɛ anigye, Trump kyerɛw wɔ Truth Social so sɛ ɔrehyira Tammy Bruce, a ɔyɛ "Great Patriot" ne television dwumayɛni, sɛ ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ United States ananmusini abediakyire wɔ United Nations. Asɛm yi maa nnipa pii adwene hinhim. Wɔ amanyɔsɛm mu no, wɔka sɛ Tammy Bruce yɛ obi a ne ho kyerɛ ne man, na ne ho a ɔbɛkɔ amanaman ntam no bɛma United States anya ɔkwan foforɔ a wɔbɛfa so aka wɔn asɛm. Nanso, bere a yɛretwɛn saa nsakraeɛ yi, nsɛm bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛbɛn. Wɔ Ghana Revenue Authority (GRA) dwumayɛbea, ɛnyɛ amanyɔsɛm nko ara na wɔreka, na mmom ɛyɛ akwantu ne dwumadie mu nsesaeɛ. Wɔkaa asɛm no sɛ, tete no, bere a wɔpɛ sɛ wosusu ngo a ɛwɔ tanker kɛseɛ bi mu no, na wɔde "dipstick" kyerɛ no. Ɛno kyerɛ sɛ ɔpanyin a ɔwɔ hɔ no bɛforo ladder a ɛwɔ tanker no so kɔ soro, na waka dipstick no ama no adu ase. Akyerɛ sɛ, asiane kɛseɛ wɔ hɔ. Eyi ne asɛm a ɛfa yɛn nyinaa ho. Ɛnyɛ nea ɛfa amanyɔsɛm nko ara, nanso ɛfa ɔkwan a yɛfa so yɛ nneɛma wɔ akwantu mu. Sɛ yɛkɔ so kura tete abrabɔ a, yɛbɛhwere akwantu no mu akwantufo. Nneɛma a atwam no, ɛsɛ sɛ yɛgyaa hɔ ma yɛnni nneɛma foforɔ a ɛbɛma yɛn nkwatibea atena hɔ yie. Tammy Bruce paw a wɔpaw no no, ɛyɛ mfiase bi sɛ yɛbɛfa kwan foforɔ so. - Some farmers also rely on lenders to make cash flow projections with their input.
